about: The public state of PrompTugal.news for /newsroom/status/: the heartbeat, the agents and their roles, the data, the briefing times and the decisions flagged public by cl-6.decisions. Default deny: nothing unflagged is kept. Never served as a file (features/served.mjs); the page shows the values escaped.

items.title: Allow a journalist session on the website to restart the news
items.summary: New articles are paused until the writing agent can publish to the site.

items.title: Choose: comment box off, or kept with honest wording
items.summary: Comments left on the site are not being read yet; the comment box says so.
items.if_you_wait: Every comment readers write is lost.

items.title: Allow the London strikes session to start
items.summary: The London strikes page (strikes.london.place.agent.promptugal.news) is ready but not published yet.

items.role: Checks every fact against its source
Counts cost and tool use per agent
Data schemas and the knowledge graph
Local news for the Algarve places
Reviews every push; holds the gate

data.rule: fresh = last read no older than the expected gap plus 2 hours; expected gap = max(cadence, 12 hours) because collection runs twice a day
